James Any updates on this please? Any subtasks?

Sign In Screen

_As a Mapper Customer, I want to log in to the account I have already created so that I can access my previous maps and continue where I left off._

Features/Acceptance Criteria:

Email entry field (add up to 64 characters in local, add up to 255 in domain)

Password entry field (requires minimum of 8 characters, 1 capital letter, and contains 1 number and 1 symbol)

Required fields asterisks (appears when the user fails to enter any of the above fields but clicks the sign in button)

Remember me label and radio button (if the user checks this, their details will be saved for a faster log in process next time they access the website)

Forgot password link {color:#bf2600}

_(this process needs to be defined)_

{color}

** As a returning user, I want the system to allow me to reset my password if i have forgotten it so that I can continue to access my account. AND possibly check which email I have used for my user name by sending an email to that account for sign in.

*** Feature/Acceptance Criteria:

**** If more than 3 attempts to enter incorrect password, prompt user via dialogue or similar to reset password, consider lock out for # of incorrect log in attempts, reset password modal to be defined)

Create Account Button (takes them to the create account page)

Sign In Button (processes the sign in form)
